review_role: Independent fresh read-only CI correction review; no source edits, new commits, PR changes or further agents.

findings.title: Make failed evidence collection affect the CI result after successful qualification.
findings.description: The CLI prints collection_status, missing_expected_records and read_issues but always returns normally. Thus a selected required record that cannot be read, a missing expected record, or even a missing source directory still yields a successful staging step and an uploadable manifest. If the prior qualification steps succeeded, GitHub reports a green job even though promised evidence is absent. The manifest makes the loss inspectable, but no workflow guard enforces completeness for a successful qualification job.
findings.reproduction: Create all EXPECTED_RECORDS as regular files and inject OSError(errno=5) only when opening coverage.json. Execute the exact candidate main(). It returns success, writes STAGED_WITH_READ_ISSUES, reports only coverage.json missing, and leaves no staged coverage.json. Separately, run the unmodified CLI against a nonexistent source: exit 0 with a manifest and no included files.
findings.requested_change: Keep writing the manifest and keep the upload step under always(). Return nonzero for unexpected collection/read failure, and enforce presence of required top-level records when the preceding qualification job status was successful. Partial evidence after already failed or cancelled gates can remain explicitly partial. Expected pytest symlink and reproducible-unit-fixture exclusions must remain non-failing.
findings.validation_needed: CLI negative fixtures must exercise exit status for unreadable required evidence and missing required evidence after successful qualification; failed-suite partial evidence must still be uploaded. Confirm prior qualification failure cannot be masked.
